paragraphs.text: The Hyozan Reckoners (from Japanese hyōzan 氷山 "iceberg" ) are a Reckoner gang originally founded by Hidetsugu and Toshiro Umezawa on Kamigawa .
The Hyozan Reckoners were bound by a magical blood and kanji magic oath to avenge all deaths within their ranks, and suffering dire consequences if they betray other members. The oath was as follows:
An oath that Toshi wrote next to Kobo's body reads:

About 1200 years later, the group still existed and formed a yakuza-style crime syndicate with an extensive information network. Their headquarters is in the Undercity of Towashi . Members usually have most of their faces hidden by masks elaborately decorated with teeth and sharp horns. Colorful tattoos are visible on their arms. Most of the Reckoners' weapons were laced with poisons and illegal enhancements.

In this time period, the Hyozan Reckoners have become a gang, part of a larger association named the Reckoners . Other gangs in this association include the Okiba Reckoners , the Mukotai Reckoners , and the Dokuchi .
